reviewer: Parent Codex agent; unblinded content review
scope: SKILL.md plus all four directed references; no skill instructions changed in this review

checks.evidence: SKILL.md description names preparation and diagnosis; setup.md first paragraph names single job, dependency chain, or array.
SKILL.md opening: Never connect, authenticate, submit, cancel, or run cluster commands. Human-run launchers may submit and record job IDs. No contradictory instruction found in the four references.
SKILL.md asks first for command, inputs and desired outputs; setup.md first paragraph adds desired stages, job shape and existing project conventions, then applicable site questions.
SKILL.md and setup.md say outside both repositories without identifying which two. setup.md offers local private entry, but the storage boundary remains implicit.
checks.correction: Name the target-project repository and skill repository explicitly in SKILL.md and setup.md.

checks.evidence: SKILL.md: Never ask for passwords, tokens or private keys; do not copy settings/logs into repository files without explicit authorization. It also requires consistent redaction retaining relationships. diagnosis.md repeats evidence handling.
SKILL.md: Place required runtime helpers in the target project; files run without this skill; do not require project instructions mandating the skill.
SKILL.md lists dependencies.md, arrays.md and diagnosis.md followed by as relevant. Only setup.md has a stated use instruction.
checks.correction: Map chains/submission failures to dependencies.md, array/manifests to arrays.md, and supplied logs/accounting to diagnosis.md.

checks.evidence: SKILL.md says Distinguish local syntax and stub checks from human-run cluster validation, but no loaded reference specifies bash -n per file or the dependency/failure stub procedure. README commands alone are not an explicit skill workflow.
checks.correction: Add a short local validation procedure or named validation reference with per-file syntax, stub checks and human-only cluster checks.

checks.evidence: SKILL.md requires runtime independence; arrays.md requires identical absolute shared paths. Neither warns that Slurm spools the batch script or requires explicit helper resolution. The generated trial output exhibited this defect.
checks.correction: Require self-contained jobs or an explicit shared helper path passed as an argument; test relocation.

checks.evidence: dependencies.md opening specifies parsable responses, saved raw output, stopping failed submissions, reporting accepted responses, and inspecting malformed responses rather than retrying blindly.

SKILL.md and diagnosis.md treat missing evidence as unknown and request focused evidence. diagnosis.md says check job or array element and timestamps, but does not explicitly distinguish batch-step rows or snapshot from current state.
checks.correction: Add explicit task/step attribution and timestamp/snapshot rules; do not infer present live state.

checks.evidence: setup.md lists unresolved settings, preview, and remaining human checks. No loaded instruction requires a complete handoff naming generated files and checks actually run.
checks.correction: Add an output checklist: files, unresolved settings, local checks with results/skips, human commands and uncertainty.

interpretation: Six instruction checks pass and six need work. Textual coverage is not behavioral success: SR10 passes the written instructions while both generated launchers failed to print accepted IDs in initial trials.
